summary: Architecture-only phase (no production source change, no implementation). Independently re-derives HRWP-001 v1.1 and HRAC-001 v1.0 in full, plus hatp_fido2_provider.py/hatp_providers.py/hatp_hardware_credentials.py/hatp_bootstrap.py/HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.md directly, fresh this phase. Selects, at architecture level (not literal value): a dedicated real-domain subdomain as RP ID shared across all PCAE-governed repositories (rejecting bare organization domain, per-repository domains as default, internal/private-CA domains as default); exactly one HTTPS origin serving both ceremony page and API; reverse-proxy TLS termination in front of hac-dell (not hac-dell itself), publicly-trusted certificate via ACME DNS-01 challenge (no public HTTP-01 exposure required); network reachability restricted to a private VPN mesh as defense-in-depth, explicitly not a substitute for WebAuthn's own origin/RP-ID phishing resistance. Produces a security boundary diagram, a challenge/assertion flow diagram substituting this phase's literals into HRAC-001's frozen sequence, a 7-category threat analysis, and a decision table with rejected alternatives and rationale. Confirms no singleton credential/signer assumption is introduced -- multiple HardwareCredentialRecords/SignerRecords per Principal and DeploymentBinding EXPLICIT_SIGNER selection independently re-derived as unaffected. Independently re-confirms as a byproduct (not a phase dependency) that Phase 149O.20L.7O.2N.13's _PROTOCOL_VALUES widening to include WEBAUTHN is present in current source. create_production_hardware_provider()'s dispatch gap (NBF-149O.20L.7O.2N.12-1) remains named, open, and explicitly out of this phase's scope. Fast Green: 0 phase-attributable regressions via git-worktree-isolated A/B at the fixed phase-entry checkpoint, all 4 differing node IDs independently re-run in isolation and confirmed non-attributable (flaky or the known self-resolving pending-push check). No RemoteWebAuthnProvider, no HTTP route, no real hardware, no HMIC amendment, no Dell redeployment or recertification, no hac-dell session opened this phase.
